name: Friend
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of choosing friends wisely, warning against associating with those who are angry or contentious, as they can lead to strife and division. True friendship is characterized by steadfast love and loyalty, with some friends even described as closer than a brother. A righteous person's conduct and purity of heart attract genuine friendship, and being friendly oneself is essential to cultivating such relationships. Ultimately, the Bible calls believers to be discerning in their friendships, valuing those who encourage righteousness and faithful support.
